notes: This is a composition and autotile smoke-test map, not a finished game level.
Ground cell textures use deterministic random selection from four variants per material.
Tree and plant sprites are scaled 4x with nearest-neighbour filtering for the 64px ground grid.
The winding river uses a narrow four-neighbour sand bank; occasional bends widen into pools.
Path rasterization inserts orthogonal bridges so autotile cells remain connected.
The source props are Kenney Roguelike/RPG assets under CC0-1.0.
